objective: Independently decide whether the packaged regression suite and inspected controls close GB06-R01 through GB06-R07 for the explicitly partial Chapter 1 movement, breathing and combat slice.
required_inputs: A disposable copy of the exact reviewed source hashes
The prior findings and current durable evidence
required_checks: Run npm run validate:ops in a new disposable copy.
Run PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/tmp/survival-playwright npm run test:gate-b in that copy.
Verify all 19 expected-failure probes exit nonzero and replace authoritative evidence with a current revision/hash-bound passed:false result before the final clean run.

Verify explicit rejection of placement, precombat HP, computed resolver, attack-definition damage/poise/reach/arc, active windup/active, direct and Set.prototype hit-set mutation, direct HP event reentry, nested damage-method reentry, death-state reentry, kill-event reentry, updater registration/list mutation and forced-failure cases.
Inspect the final clean evidence for exact current bindings, two fresh 667x375 contexts, no errors, three full-health actors, three proven deaths, and equal positive engine/game/combat step counts.

Review the sealed instance/prototype call chain, immutable attack snapshots, single-use target-bound damage/telemetry authorization, protected death state, pinned driver contract, projectile/vitals separation and guarded updater list against the causes of GB06-R01 through GB06-R07.
acceptance_criteria: The runner exercises the complete fixed-step updater chain with live RAF stopped.
Movement, breathing and combat use normal production paths without placement, health, immunity, progression or resolver shortcuts.
Every protected raid HP transition has exactly one authenticated production damage call and normal hit telemetry.
Failed or interrupted attempts cannot leave authoritative passing evidence current.
The clean result is semantically repeatable and bound to the exact reviewed source/build/revision.
All claims remain explicitly limited to the partial scripted slice.
decision_rule: PASS only if every required check completes and no unresolved high-severity bypass or contradictory evidence remains in this partial scope. Otherwise FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE.
constraints: Do not trust implementer prose or README.md as evidence.
Run builds, tests and adversarial mutations only in a disposable copy.
Do not alter shared product, tests, state, evidence, prior reviews or remote state.
The only permitted shared edit is the expected output review.
Do not approve B1, B2, B3, B4, C1, D3, performance, play feel, full Gate B, full playtime, real-device behavior or release.
known_risks: SwiftShader mobile emulation is not a physical-device performance result.
The source-aware scripted slice is not a source-blind usability or play-feel evaluation.
The full opening-to-ending route remains a separate Gate C task.
rollback_instructions: Remove the engine test step, Gate B driver/runner, package script and evidence entry; restore state to revision 2026-07-31.2.
